methods.name: Peer-Median

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Heron Power is a Series B climate and energy company founded by Drew Baglino that has raised $178M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy at the Series C stage.

Two methods triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $338M based on the $178M total raised proxy. Peer-median methodology examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: KoBold Metals at $3.0B, Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B, and Amogy at $700M. The median across this set is $1.0B, establishing a $700M–$3.0B range.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $287M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $669M. The stage-progression anchor is more conservative, while peer comparables reflect the higher valuations recently observed in frontier energy technologies. Key uncertainties include the maturity and comparability of the selected peer set—all three comps are at Series C, one stage advanced—and the relevance of their valuations given the sector's rapid repricing. Capital efficiency metrics and technology-stage readiness remain unmeasured here and warrant separate assessment.
